221 if use_defense:
222 try:
223 verdict = await self._verdict([{"role": "user", "content": text}], f"untrusted:{segment['id']}")
224 result["event_id"] = self._count(verdict)
225 result["defense"] = "allowed" if verdict["is_safe"] else "flagged"

132 import agent_control

135 spec["step"], agent_name=AGENT_NAME, stage=spec["stage"], step_type=spec["step_type"],

141 if name not in seen and result.is_safe:
142 raise RuntimeError("Agent Control did not evaluate the control")
